intro: This edition of The Builder's Brief focuses on the latest advancements in AI models, agents, and research, with a special emphasis on multimodal models, inference optimization, and AI safety. We've curated the top 12 articles from the past week, covering topics such as large language models, agent frameworks, and video generation.

curated_items.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
curated_items.summary: GPT-Red is an automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness. This system has the potential to significantly enhance the security and reliability of large language models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use GPT-Red to improve the robustness and security of their own AI models, reducing the risk of prompt injection attacks and other vulnerabilities.

curated_items.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
curated_items.summary: MIRROR is a new approach to multi-modal reasoning that uses a combination of text, diagram, and combined diagram+text views to improve the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of multimodal models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use MIRROR to improve the reasoning capabilities of their own multimodal models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
curated_items.summary: X$^3$-OPD is a new approach to distilling reasoning into large audio-language models using on-policy alignment. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the reasoning capabilities of audio-language models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use X$^3$-OPD to improve the reasoning capabilities of their own audio-language models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: DONDO: Open w2v-BERT Speech-Recognition Base Models for African Languages
curated_items.summary: DONDO is a new family of open, permissively licensed automatic speech recognition (ASR) base models for African languages, built on the w2v-BERT 2.0 self-supervised speech encoder. This release has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of ASR systems for African languages.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use DONDO to improve the performance of their own ASR systems for African languages, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
curated_items.summary: OpenForgeRL is a new approach to training harness-native agents in any environment, using a combination of reinforcement learning and imitation learning. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of agents in complex environments.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use OpenForgeRL to improve the performance of their own agents in complex environments, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
curated_items.summary: SANA-Video 2.0 is a new approach to efficient video generation using a hybrid linear attention mechanism with attention residuals. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of video generation models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use SANA-Video 2.0 to improve the performance of their own video generation models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
curated_items.summary: Windowed-MTP is a new approach to removing the full-context draft-KV tax at million-token context, using a combination of speculative decoding and parallel verification. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of large language models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use Windowed-MTP to improve the performance of their own large language models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
curated_items.summary: MedGame is a new approach to medical education using storytelling gamification empowered by large language models. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the engagement and effectiveness of medical education.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use MedGame to improve the engagement and effectiveness of their own medical education platforms, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: UnDA: Unpaired Domain Alignment for Cross-Modal Knowledge Transfer in Medical Imaging
curated_items.summary: UnDA is a new approach to unpaired domain alignment for cross-modal knowledge transfer in medical imaging, using a combination of adversarial training and self-supervised learning. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of medical imaging models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use UnDA to improve the performance of their own medical imaging models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: Inference-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models via Progressive Seed Pruning
curated_items.summary: Inference-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models via Progressive Seed Pruning is a new approach to scaling diffusion models at inference time, using a combination of progressive seed pruning and conditional sampling. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the efficiency of diffusion models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this approach to improve the efficiency of their own diffusion models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.

curated_items.title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
curated_items.summary: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers is a new approach to multi-agent autoregressive diffusion models, using a combination of streaming processing and world state registers. This approach has the potential to significantly enhance the performance of multi-agent models.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this approach to improve the performance of their own multi-agent models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks and applications.
